enumeration_note: One VWAP-band-breakout skeleton taught twice: a basic band-only version (2:1) then a filtered version adding an EMA-200 trend gate and POC-within-bands confluence (1.5:1). These differ only in confirmation mechanic and target-R (compatible variation, Rule 3), so enumerated as one strategy with two variants; long/short are symmetric directions of the same setup, not opposition.

coaching_notes: Traders usually try to avoid consolidating markets; when the market is sideways/consolidating the price moves between the VWAP bands.
Even though the VWAP indicator is powerful, the band-only version still produces a lot of false signals â€” add the filters to avoid entering on a fakeout instead of a breakout.
element_inventory: Indicator: VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price) with upper and lower bands added to chart
LONG entry (basic): price breaks out above the upper VWAP band
SHORT entry (basic): price breaks below the lower VWAP band
LONG entry (filtered): CM EMA Trend Bars candle is green (uptrend) AND price breaks above upper VWAP band AND POC is within the VWAP bands
SHORT entry (filtered): candle is red (downtrend) AND candle closes below the VWAP band AND POC is within the VWAP bands
Stop loss LONG: recent swing low (or slightly below VWAP if swing low is near the VWAP line)
Stop loss SHORT: recent swing high (or just above VWAP if swing high is near the VWAP line)
Filter indicator: Volume Profile Fixed Range (row size 36, number of bars 300) to locate the Point of Control
POC confluence gate: Point of Control (highest-traded-volume price level) must fall within the VWAP bands at breakout
Trend filter indicator: CM EMA Trend Bars with EMA set to 200; candle color defines trend (green uptrend / red downtrend)
strategies.entry_summary: Enter on a VWAP-band breakout in the direction of the break: LONG when price breaks above the upper VWAP band, SHORT when price breaks below/closes below the lower VWAP band. The filtered variant additionally requires the CM EMA Trend Bars candle color to confirm the larger trend (green = uptrend for longs, red = downtrend for shorts, EMA set to 200) and the Volume Profile Point of Control (POC) to sit within the VWAP bands at the moment of breakout.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop loss at the recent swing low (long) or recent swing high (short); if that level is very close to the VWAP line, place the stop slightly below/above the VWAP instead. Take profit at a fixed risk-to-reward multiple (2:1 in the basic band-only variant, 1.5:1 in the filtered variant).
strategies.name: vwap_band_breakout

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Break of VWAP band only (no EMA trend or POC filter); acknowledged by the speaker to produce many false signals
variants.transcript_quote: We will enter into a buy position whenever the price breaks out above the upper V-wap band. We will be placing the stoploss at the recent swing low and for the take profit we will target a 2 times risk-to-reward ratio.
variants.variant_label: Basic VWAP band breakout, 2:1 target, no filters

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Adds CM EMA Trend Bars (EMA 200) candle-color trend filter AND requires Volume Profile POC to be within the VWAP bands at breakout
variants.transcript_quote: Firstly the candlestick will need to be green. This shows us that we are currently in an uptrend. Secondly, the price must break above the upper V-wap band... Thirdly, the Point of control must be within the V-wap bands when the price breaks out above the upper V-wap band. When all of these conditions have been met we will enter into a buy position.
variants.variant_label: Filtered VWAP band breakout with EMA-200 trend + POC-within-bands, 1.5:1 target
